name: Suture Attendant
languages: Common; cannot speak while its mask is sealed.
bio: Someone Must Hurt: user-supplied homebrew for five 8th-level characters using 2014 rules. CR 2 is the source's design estimate, not a playtest result. Use this one sheet for both attendant portraits and all attendant tokens. These are altered living people, not mindless undead: they can be deceived, persuaded, charmed or spared. When an attendant falls, its mask can briefly open so it can say, 'I had a family.' Keep each token's HP independent.

traits.name: Living Sutures
traits.description: Once per turn, when the attendant hits a Medium or smaller creature with Surgical Needle, it can grapple that creature (escape DC 14). Only one creature can be grappled by this attendant at a time.

traits.name: Death Spasm
traits.description: When reduced to 0 HP, its sutures burst. Every creature within 5 feet must make a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw, taking 7 (2d6) piercing damage on a failure. A successful save takes no damage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Makes two Surgical Needle attacks. Resolve each attack separately.

actions.name: Surgical Needle
actions.description: Average hit damage 10. Living Sutures can grapple a Medium or smaller creature hit by this attack once per turn (escape DC 14); maximum one grappled creature at a time.
